verdict.rationale: AMD's official ROCm platform is the first-party SDK for Instinct GPUs. Its documentation covers compilers, runtimes, the HIP runtime and HIP C++ programming model, math, compute and communication libraries, profiling and debugging tools, and the AMD SMI management tool. MI325X (gfx942) appears in ROCm's architecture reference, and the docs publish an llms.txt for AI-assisted development. Community questions about whether the stack works in practice are general skepticism, not a concrete counter-example, so they lower confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building against ROCm/HIP on MI325X, and detail on SDK language bindings, versioning and API reference depth (no OpenAPI or markdown docs found, though neither is essential for a hardware SDK).
